patch.value: loadGraphForContext() and runPmJson() spawned `pm list-all` from the workspace cwd without forwarding the tracker path, so every analytics command (analyze/cycles/path/critical-path/explain/topo-sort/impact) and sync failed with tracker_not_initialized in workspaces initialized with a custom --pm-path. The CLI passes the resolved pm_root to extension command contexts (verified empirically; all sibling fleet packages already forward --path). Fix: honor ctx.pm_root in loadGraphForContext/runPmJson/getWorkspace; also derive the logical workspace (and projectKey) from the parent of hidden storage dirs like .pm.
Analytics and sync ignore ctx.pm_root: tracker_not_initialized under custom --pm-path

loadGraphForContext/runPmJson/getWorkspace now honor ctx.pm_root; workspaceFromPmRoot strips hidden storage dirs; verified analyze works under --pm-path .pm with correct projectKey; integration test added.
